blocker_code_meanings.CURATION_NOT_CURATED: the work item is still RAW; no curator has reached a conclusion
blocker_code_meanings.DATASET_NOT_PUBLISHED: the canonical dataset is still BUILDING
blocker_code_meanings.EVIDENCE_BUILD_QUARANTINED: the evidence build is quarantined and not a permitted rule source
blocker_code_meanings.LEGACY_SEVERITY_IS_NOT_AN_OUTCOME: the legacy risk and severity fields are the old project's unreviewed interpretation; they are recorded here as raw text and are never copied into a rule outcome
blocker_code_meanings.NO_APPROVAL_ENVELOPE: no WP-10 rule approval envelope names this candidate
blocker_code_meanings.NO_APPROVED_REVISION: no immutable curation revision has been approved, so a rule would have nothing exact to descend from
blocker_code_meanings.NO_EVIDENCE_LINK: the legacy row could not be linked to an evidence record, so a rule built from it could cite nothing (SAFETY-INV-006)
blocker_code_meanings.PROTOCOL_NOT_APPROVED: the curation protocol awaits expert review, so there is no approved standard to curate against

note: Every candidate is ineligible. The blockers are decisions people have not made yet, and none of them can be cleared by code.
promotion_policy: This file is an inventory. It creates no rule, grants no eligibility, and copies no legacy severity or risk value into a rule outcome. Those values appear here as raw text under raw_* fields precisely so that reading them is obviously reading the old project's unreviewed opinion, not this project's finding.
